text:
maya (PM): Quick sync — we need a compact decision on model retirement economics + pin exceptions before EOD. customers asking for clearer timelines.

igor (Eng): +1. what's the target migration velocity? do we have runway for 2-week canaries?

maya (PM): Thinking phased velocity: 3 cohorts over 8 weeks (canary 2w, cohort A 3w, cohort B 3w). allows staggered rollbacks.

nora (ML): Need benchmark gates before canary: quality regression < 1.5% on eval suite OR no increase in hallucination alerts, and embedding drift < 0.02 cosine on sampled slice.

kevin (Support): We also need a customer opt-in/opt-out flow. For enterprise customers, they'll likely request pinned versions for at least 30d during transition.

tara (EM): Right — propose default soft-pin TTL = 30d, with PM-approved exceptions. Also add a premium paid pin for 90d via contract.

igor (Eng): Ops constraints: our Dedicated pools can handle ~250k tokens/day for the new variant without impacting latency SLO, but if many customers request pins we'll need fallback routing to quantized variant.

nora (ML): Can we define an automated fallback policy? e.g., route to quantized v1 if latency p95 > 300ms for >5 minutes.

igor (Eng): Yes, runtime supports that. We'll implement a policy:
```json
{
  "trigger": "p95_latency>300ms",
  "window": "5m",
  "fallback": "model-quant-v1",
  "notify": "#product"
}
```

maya (PM): Nice. For launch gates, propose: bench pass (latency, cost, quality), canary healthy 48h, no critical customer regressions for 7d.

nora (ML): Bench pass specifics: p95 gen latency < 250ms on baseline hw; token cost delta <= +12%; top-1 rerank accuracy change <= 0.5%.

kevin (Support): Also track support signal: increase in triaged tickets per 10k calls. If >5x baseline for 24h -> rollback.

maya (PM): Comms plan: 1) Early notice to customers in pin-eligible list 14d out, 2) soft opt-in window with migration credits, 3) mandatory cutover only after 30d unless customer requests extension.

igor (Eng): For internal rollout, need a migration toggle per-tenant + metric gates. Ops-bot, can you create a dashboard template with these KPIs?

ops-bot: Dashboard template created: metrics included: p95_latency, avg_token_cost, eval_quality_score, ticket_rate. Link: https://console.redwood.internal/d/retire-runway

nora (ML): One more: add model-version compatibility check for embedding schema. If new embeddings change dims or dtype -> require adapter layer.

maya (PM): Good call. Add compatibility shim as must-have for customers using embeddings in saved pipelines.

kevin (Support): We'll draft a customer-facing migration FAQ and a rollback contact list. Want to review tomorrow.

tara (EM): Action items:
- maya: finalize customer comm language and TTL policy (today)
- igor: implement fallback policy + per-tenant toggle (sprint goal)
- nora: publish benchmark suite + thresholds (48h)
- kevin: draft FAQ + support runbook (tomorrow)
- ops-bot: ensure dashboard alerts wired to #product and PagerDuty

maya (PM): Thanks all. If no objections, we'll run the canary with cohort-0 on Monday. :thumbsup:

igor (Eng): No objections from infra.

nora (ML): Good from ML side.

kevin (Support): Fine by support.

maya (PM): Closing thread — logging decisions into the catalog lifecycle doc and tagging impacted customers.
